source_title: BJP vs INDIA Bloc: Giriraj Singh's 'Thieves' Jibe at Opposition Ahead of Delhi Mega Rally!
source_excerpt:
Political tensions have escalated ahead of the INDIA bloc's mega rally scheduled for November 1 at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan. Before the opposition's massive demonstration, Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence is set to host a public impeachment-style mock proceeding against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar at 3:30 PM. The opposition alliance plans to use the symbolic exercise to highlight its allegations of electoral irregularities and alleged vote theft during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. However, the BJP has launched a sharp counterattack against the opposition's campaign. Union Minister Giriraj Singh criticised the INDIA bloc's upcoming rally, dismissing its allegations of vote theft. Taking a swipe at the opposition, he said that votes are not being stolen; rather, people have stopped voting for those he described as thieves. Giriraj Singh also expressed concerns over the possibility of disruptions during the November 1 rally, referring to previous incidents involving opposition protests near Parliament, the Prime Minister's residence and other public institutions. His remarks have added another dimension to the ongoing political confrontation between the BJP and the Congress-led opposition. While the INDIA bloc is preparing to intensify its campaign against the Election Commission through the mock impeachment programme and the Ramlila Maidan rally, the BJP continues to challenge the opposition's allegations. With both sides exchanging sharp political attacks, Delhi is gearing up for another day of high-voltage political activity. The developments are expected to bring the debate over electoral transparency, voter lists and the Election Commission back into the national political spotlight.
